info.title: Trace API
info.description: Multi-carrier package tracking API. Send a tracking number and receive normalized, dated events when a source returns usable data. The catalog contains 80+ accepted carrier codes, but automatic detection and live event availability vary. Supports batch tracking, carrier overrides, and HMAC-signed webhooks.

bearerAuth.description: API key prefixed with "trc_live_" or "trc_test_". Both types use real sources and account quotas on /v1/track. Choose /v1/sandbox/track explicitly for simulated events without lookup quota. Obtain a key at https://traceapi.dev/signup.

timestamp.description: UTC scan time, or null when the source does not provide a verifiable timezone. Use timestamp_local without timezone conversion when null.

timestamp_local.description: Source civil date/time, present when timestamp is null. It is not a UTC instant.

timestamp_precision.description: Precision of timestamp_local; minute precision uses :00 seconds.

stale.description: True only for explicitly requested outage fallback. Previously verified data, never a new observation.

acquisition.description: Queue readiness checks a recent browser-worker heartbeat; it is not a live carrier lookup.

secret.description: Keep this signing secret private on your server.

csv.description: UTF-8 CSV text, up to 750 KB. Supports tracking_number, carrier, order_id, reference, destination_country columns.

post.summary: Simulate shipment states without live carrier requests
post.description: Fixed fixtures for integration testing. Requires an API key and normal per-minute admission, but consumes no monthly lookup quota and creates no cache entries, watches or webhooks. Never send real shipment numbers. The unknown_timezone scenario has a null UTC timestamp and explicit local-time metadata. Key prefixes do not select sandbox mode.

400.description: Invalid scenario or unexpected request fields

post.description: Send a tracking number. Trace auto-detects selected formats unless you provide a catalogued carrier code, then returns a normalized status and dated events from a source page containing the requested number. Catalog inclusion does not guarantee live events or carrier-authoritative accuracy. Successful results are cached for 30 minutes. If no source contains the number or no usable events can be parsed, the API returns 503 instead of an empty pending result. With allow_stale=true it can return clearly marked previously verified data younger than 24 hours after a failed live attempt.

allow_stale.description: On source unavailability, permit previously verified cache data younger than 24 hours. Check stale, data_freshness and last_checked_at. No notifications or watch state updates occur from stale responses. A successful stale response counts as one lookup.

carrier.description: Optional carrier override, such as ups, fedex, dhl, or israelpost.

503.description: No tracking source returned usable data; retry shortly

post.summary: Track up to 20 packages in one request
post.description: Send an array of tracking numbers. Selected formats are auto-detected; an accepted carrier override can be supplied for others. Items are tracked independently and results remain in input order. An item may contain an error when its sources return no usable events. A 503 is returned when every item fails.

allow_stale.description: On source unavailability, permit previously verified cache data younger than 24 hours. Check stale, data_freshness and last_checked_at. No notifications or watch state updates occur from stale responses. A successful stale response counts as one lookup.

carrier.description: Optional carrier override applied to each tracking number.

failed_count.description: Number of items that could not return verified tracking data.

402.description: Insufficient monthly quota for the submitted batch; no source requests are made

503.description: All items failed (results array), or acquisition/quota infrastructure is unavailable (error object). Mixed success returns 200. Honor Retry-After.

200.description: Carrier-code catalog; automatic detection and live source availability vary by carrier

503.description: Database or browser-worker readiness is unavailable
Database or browser-worker readiness is unavailable

patch.description: Paused endpoints hold unsent deliveries. Resume allows pending delivery; deletion removes its history.

post.description: 24-hour overlap: new attempts carry v1 signatures for both secrets. Accept any matching v1. A second rotation during overlap is rejected with 409. Returns previous_secret_expires_at.

404.description: Webhook not found for this account

get.description: Delivery aggregate plus diagnostic. Attempt-level history begins with this release; old aggregates are retained.

post.summary: Send one signed test to your receiver
post.description: Makes one receiver request and persists a diagnostic record; no automatic retry. HTTP 200 can have ok=false when the receiver rejects the test. This creates a real outbound notification; sandbox tracking does not.

404.description: Webhook not found for this account

502.description: Receiver test could not be completed

post.description: Idempotent replay returns 200, not 201. Acquisition is asynchronous; pending is not verified tracking. Six-hour refreshes for up to 30 days, with active record caps (100/1000/5000/20000 by plan) and 20,000 stored records per tenant. Each successful refresh uses one monthly lookup; failures release reservations. No source coverage guarantee.

patch.description: Tracking identity is immutable. Closed records cannot be resumed; create a new cycle. Existing records and verified history are retained.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true (default) returns active alerts; false includes resolved history.

post.description: Import results report record creation, not successful carrier acquisition. Monitoring subsequently uses the same shipment budget. Two unfinished imports per tenant; bounded chunks per tenant per cycle. Cancellation preserves completed rows.

get.description: Cohort uses record creation date, including unverified shipments. Observed transit median requires transit and delivered scans and UTC for all scans; excludes unknown/local times and incomplete histories. Does not rank carriers or promise an SLA. CSV returns text/csv. At most 20,000 records per window.

422.description: Reduce the cohort window to at most 20,000 records

post.description: Finished deliveries only, active endpoint required. Preserves event ID/payload and all recorded attempts; adds replay audit, fresh signed attempt. At most 60 replays per tenant/hour. No automatic historical replay on deployment.
